_note: Every app on the company computer. Names are working names: change them here and every screen follows. `accent` is the app's colour. `layer` is "business" (the tested business's own tools) or "sandbox" (the test bench around it, made by Expanza). `plain` says what the app is in plain words; show it next to the name everywhere. `icon` names a drawing in applications/lib/icons.js. `status` is ready (has a folder in applications/<id>/) or soon (opens the placeholder). `roles` are the engine roles that would use the app. Order is the order in the switcher and on the search engine's home (which leaves itself out). `home` is the search engine, the front door at /: rename it here.
